transport.title: Connection Type
transport.description: Use Legacy Tuya for older local-control RoboVacs. Use Eufy Clean Cloud for newer cloud/MQTT models.

name.title: Name
name.description: Arbitrary name for your Eufy Robovac

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: IP Address of your Eufy Robovac. Required for Legacy Tuya 3.3 local control.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Required for legacy mode. Optional for cloud/MQTT mode when the Eufy Clean account has a single RoboVac; otherwise use the startup log to choose one.

deviceModel.title: Eufy Clean Device Model
deviceModel.description: Optional model code override for cloud/MQTT mode. The plugin normally discovers this from Eufy Clean.

deviceKey.title: Tuya Device Key
deviceKey.description: Tuya/Eufy Device/Local Key. Required for Legacy Tuya 3.3 local control.

eufyEmail.title: Eufy Clean Email
eufyEmail.description: Eufy Clean account email. Used only for Eufy Clean cloud/MQTT mode.

eufyPassword.title: Eufy Clean Password
eufyPassword.description: Eufy Clean account password. Used only for Eufy Clean cloud/MQTT mode when no access token is supplied.

eufyAccessToken.title: Eufy Clean Access Token
eufyAccessToken.description: Optional Eufy Clean API access token. Username and password are still recommended so MQTT credentials can be discovered.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Eufy Clean account country code.

eufyApiBaseUrl.title: Eufy Clean API Base URL
eufyApiBaseUrl.description: Override for the Eufy Clean cloud API base URL.

eufyAiotApiBaseUrl.title: Eufy Clean AIOT API Base URL
eufyAiotApiBaseUrl.description: Advanced override for the Eufy Clean AIOT API used to discover MQTT credentials.

openudid.title: OpenUDID
openudid.description: Advanced override for the Android-style Eufy Clean client identifier. The plugin generates one automatically.

showAdvancedMqtt.title: Show Advanced MQTT Overrides
showAdvancedMqtt.description: Enable only if you need to manually override MQTT settings. The plugin normally discovers these from Eufy Clean.

mqttHost.title: MQTT Host
mqttHost.description: Advanced override. Normally discovered from the Eufy Clean API.

mqttClientId.title: MQTT Client ID
mqttClientId.description: Advanced override. Normally generated from Eufy Clean MQTT credentials.

mqttUsername.title: MQTT Username
mqttUsername.description: Advanced override. Normally discovered from the Eufy Clean API.

mqttPassword.title: MQTT Password
mqttPassword.description: Advanced override for brokers that use password authentication.

mqttCertificatePem.title: MQTT Certificate PEM
mqttCertificatePem.description: Advanced override. Normally discovered from the Eufy Clean API.

mqttPrivateKey.title: MQTT Private Key PEM
mqttPrivateKey.description: Advanced override. Normally discovered from the Eufy Clean API.

mqttCommandTopic.title: MQTT Command Topic
mqttCommandTopic.description: Advanced override. Normally derived as cmd/eufy_home/{model}/{deviceId}/req and smart/mb/out/{deviceId}.

mqttStatusTopic.title: MQTT Status Topic
mqttStatusTopic.description: Advanced override. Normally derived as cmd/eufy_home/{model}/{deviceId}/res and smart/mb/in/{deviceId}.

roomSwitches.description: Rooms - configure according to the eufy clean app.  These are optional.  If no rooms, then the Eufy Robovac will be configured for Auto mode.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.placeholder: A room number or comma-separated list of room numbers
